Fixes and easier setup for Windows and Linux / SteamOS.

- Fixed character movement slowing down after loading, especially noticeable at 4K.
- Fixed black loading-tip rectangles and solid white dialog panels after returning from missions to the ninja village. Verified with missions 1 and 2 at 4K.
- Added game text language selection under Esc > Game: English, French, German, Spanish and Italian. Restart the game after changing it.
- Added portable mode and a migration helper for existing saves, settings and compiled game data. See the README for instructions.
- Fixed Linux release builds reporting "dev" and the updater incorrectly treating Linux packages as development installations.
- Added Setup.cmd on Windows to check prerequisites and offer installation of the required Python and C++ build tools, reusing existing installations where possible.
- Improved Python/toolchain detection and missing-component messages.
- Added safer GPU buffer uploads, adapter diagnostics and persistent Windows crash logs.

Both packages are built from this tag and checked for the correct version before publication. The Linux package targets glibc 2.35 for Ubuntu 22.04 and newer, including SteamOS.

Updating: close the game and extract the package over your existing installation, preserving your saves and settings. Linux users whose previous release reports "dev" should install this update manually once; this version fixes release identification and the Linux updater check.

Known reports still under investigation: overbright training floors on some AMD GPUs and a reported mission-start crash. The robustness changes in this release are not a confirmed fix for those reports.
